qr.note: The same document shape as WhatsApp's, with everything network-specific different: the step id is namespaced `fi.mau.signal.login.qr`, the instructions are the connector's own, and the payload is an `sgnl://linkdevice` URI rather than an https one.
substituted: display_and_wait.data is a placeholder of the real length and prefix: the real value is a Signal device-linking credential

body.instructions: Scan the QR code on your Signal app to log in

unknown_flow.note: POST /login/start/nosuchflow. Signal validates the flow id. The WhatsApp bridge does not: it answers 200 and gives you the QR flow instead. Same call, same mautrix version, opposite outcomes.

body.error: User does not have login permissions
